parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the switch buttons of the wall switch, made of durable polycarbonate plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main actuator for turning electrical circuits on or off.
parts.Movement_description: It moves by a small angular or linear displacement when pressed, returning to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is another switch button of the wall switch, made of polycarbonate plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It controls a separate electrical circuit, allowing independent operation of connected devices.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly inward when pressed and returns to its neutral position after release.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is a third switch button of the wall switch, made of polycarbonate plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It acts as an additional control for another circuit or lighting fixture.
parts.Movement_description: It performs a short press motion, toggling between on and off states.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the fourth switch button of the wall switch, made of polycarbonate plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It provides an additional control interface for electrical appliances or lighting.
parts.Movement_description: It moves inward when pressed and returns outward when released.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or frame of the wall switch, made of ABS plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the internal electrical components and switch mechanisms.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and fixed to the wall surface, serving as the mounting base for the switches.
